settings.about_text:
Moore Insight LLC is a content and consulting practice founded at the intersection of ancient African heritage and modern intelligence. We believe the deepest wisdom of the past holds the keys to mastering the future.

Through media, education, and strategic consulting, we help individuals and organizations think more clearly, build more boldly, and honor the brilliance that came before us.
